author: Unreal Engine
description:
Watch this session recorded at Unreal Fest Chicago 2026 and explore how MetaHuman has evolved from an experimental tool into a production-ready standard for digital humans across games, film, and real-time experiences. 

We walk through the latest advancements in Unreal Engine 5.8, including expanded character creation workflows, support for a wide range of styles, and major improvements in runtime performance—enabling thousands of MetaHumans to run in real-time environments. 

We also share a look at what’s coming next, highlighting Epic’s continued investment in research that is unlocking new capabilities in character creation, performance capture, and rendering. 

Find out more about MetaHuman here: metahuman.com

#MetaHuman, #DigitalHumans, #MetaHuman5.8, #MH 5.8, #UE 5.8, #Unreal Engine 5.8, #UnrealFestChicago2026
title: MetaHuman in 2026: Five Years In, What's Next? | Unreal Fest Chicago 2026

author: Unreal Engine
description:
Watch this session recorded at Unreal Fest Chicago 2026 and discover how Unreal Engine 5.8 is introducing an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) integration, alongside a new set of PCG Primitives spatial operations and skills designed to support AI-assisted world building directly inside Unreal Editor. 

This session begins with a closer look at the MCP integration: the editor systems supported out of the box, the connection between Unreal Editor and the agentic LLM of your choice, and how developers can extend it. 

From there, we explore AI-assisted creation and editing of virtual worlds. Through experiments that combine LLMs with advanced Unreal Engine systems such as the Procedural Content Generation (PCG) framework, we demonstrate natural-language-driven approaches to environment creation and iteration inside the editor. title: From Words to Worlds: Integrating MCP into the Unreal Editor | Unreal Fest Chicago 2026
